## About
Trejos Roofing is a roofing contractor in Miami, run by owner Jose Trejos. When you call, Jose is the one who comes out to look at your roof and lay out what needs to be done.
We do full roof replacements on homes, and we fix flat roofs. Customers have rated us 4.2 on Google from 25 reviews, and reviewers bring up our fair pricing.

## Services
- Full roof replacement: Replacing the whole roof on your home.
- Flat roofs: We fix flat roofs, with a hard-working crew on the job.
- Estimates: Jose comes out, looks at the roof and spells out the work.

## FAQ
Q: Who comes out to give the estimate?
A: Jose, the owner. One reviewer said he was very detailed and thorough in specifying what needed to be done.

Q: How long does a full roof replacement take?
A: It depends on the house. For one reviewer, the full replacement was completed in just over a week.

Q: Do you work on flat roofs?
A: Yes. One customer had two flat roofs fixed by our crew in one day.
